steps.action: Validate parent candidate commit/tree, independent SOURCE report, remote fixed files, preflight and common model/auth configuration. Load applicable candidate AGENTS and Claude SKILL.md without modifying product.

Prepare isolated candidate/plugin and synthetic handoff workspace; bind original 220-byte benchmark prompt; keep receipt/config identifiers and approved digests. Validate CLI flags locally and approved authentication without exposing or copying key values. Permanent auth, permissions and network policy stay unchanged.

Execute mandatory four frozen mock variants through actual product boundary under the verified candidate, using the public harness as an assertion source. Use artifact/test copies outside product tree if needed. Check fixture/oracle digests first; mismatch blocks execution rather than rewriting fixture/oracle. Capture real command exit/stdout/stderr with secrets removed.

For separately authorized vendor-live normal variant, use actual get_skill_inventory -> classify_skills -> independent AGENT decision -> record_skill_selection path. Observe exactly one approved vendor classification attempt, zero JEV credential lookup/call and actual model/effort equality to central profile. Host API calls for tool turns are counted separately from the one classification attempt. Never infer deployed remote adapter availability from historical mock registration.

Read/apply/verify applicable P=ponytail, CS=cs-engineering, T=test-engineering, O=orchestrator skills with real artifacts in isolated handoff workspace. Check pre-receipt exit, post-ACK crash and duplicate reception for no loss or double completion. Selection remains Claude's reasoned decision; provider advice is not copied into receipt. Original benchmark requirements are preserved.

Observe missing-profile, unavailable-model and unsupported-option deferrals with concrete reasons; no JEV lookup/call, reactivation, retry escalation, different model/vendor/reasoning or invented selection. Empty unavailable judgments are not selected []. No additional paid failure probes unless parent-approved within remaining budget.
